page_title: LEC 0-2 ACM | Lecce v AC Milan 29/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' A player from Lecce pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Looks like Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
89' Cheveyo Mul (AC Milan) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies high over the bar.
89' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
87' The substitution is prepared. Cheveyo Mul (AC Milan) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Santiago Tomas Gimenez.
86' 0 - 2 Goal! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:2.
85' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 3:5.
81' Here is a change. Tete Morente is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Konan Ndri (Lecce).
81' Today's match ends for Ylber Ramadani who will be replaced by Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce).

80' The corner lands on the head of Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) in the middle of the box and he tries to guide his header into the far right corner, but it's misjudged and goes well wide of the right post.
80' Luka Modric (AC Milan) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

80' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
78' Lecce take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
78' Lecce can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
77' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Mike Maignan anticipates well and smothers the ball.
77' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers will be replaced by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) will replace Ruben Loftus-Cheek.
74' The current number of shots on goal is 1:4.
71' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.

70' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Wladimiro Falcone has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
69' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mike Maignan, who smothers the ball.

66' 0 - 1 Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) celebrates a stunning goal. He manages to win himself just enough space inside the box to meet the free kick and powers a perfectly placed header inside the right post.
66' Luka Modric (AC Milan) will take the free kick.
64' Today's referee Livio Marinelli rightly decides to book Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) for his harsh tackle.
63' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Medon Berisha (Lecce) replacing Mohamed Kaba.
63' It will be a substitution. Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) is ready to enter the pitch as Santiago Pierotti walks off.
62' Celebrations are cut short for AC Milan as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
62' The AC Milan players halt their celebrations as referee Livio Marinelli makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

60' GOAL! Superb work from Alexis Saelemaekers, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan), who beats Wladimiro Falcone with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
59' Luka Modric (AC Milan) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
59' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
56' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
53' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
52' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:5.
50' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
48' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Eusebio Di Francesco makes a switch. Nikola Stulic is coming on in place of Francesco Camarda (Lecce) at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' Luka Modric (AC Milan) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

45+5' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the bottom left corner, but he can't get the power to direct it past Wladimiro Falcone, who gets down to save.
45+3' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the right post. He should have scored!
45+3' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
41' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
39' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
37' The corner is swung in but AC Milan can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
37' Luka Modric (AC Milan) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
36' A header by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past Wladimiro Falcone, who makes a nice save.
33' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle. Yunus Musah (AC Milan) commits a foul after dangerous play.
30' Lecce concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
26' A cooling break is underway.
22' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:0.
17' Francesco Camarda (Lecce) makes a strong challenge and Livio Marinelli blows for a foul.
12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lecce comes to nothing.
12' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
11' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
10' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
6' Celebrations are cut short for AC Milan as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
5' Wait! Referee Livio Marinelli has indicated he is going to review the AC Milan goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.

4' A perfectly taken corner kick. Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes inside the left post, increasing the score of today's match – 0:1.
3' It will be a corner kick for AC Milan.
3' The ball is cleared after Yunus Musah (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

The players are out and the match is about to start. AC Milan will have the kick-off.
